svg.title: Index Translator server components, HTTP
svg.desc: The app puts translations and speech into their own lines, and hands the work to the engines. An image is prepared before it takes a place in the line, so a bad one never waits. Translations and transcriptions run as jobs that keep going for a while after the reader has left and can be read again. Speech is answered as WAV or as an Ogg Opus stream. Startup is drawn in the previous diagram, the engines in the next ones. a request: Web app → src/app.ts → Engines.
